Assisted Hand Exercise
The Problem

Losing fine motor control affects more than your grip.

Buttoning a shirt, holding a cup, typing a message, turning a key: tasks nobody thinks about until they are difficult again.

Traditional recovery paths work, but they can be slow, easy to under-do, and hard to track. This glove is built to close that gap with guided, repeatable movement support at home.

Where recovery often gets stuck

  • In-clinic therapy can be hard to repeat often enough between visits
  • At-home stretching routines are easy to under-do or skip
  • Stress balls and putty do not guide full finger opening and closing
  • Small progress can be difficult for patients and caregivers to notice

How It Helps

Four practical levels of support, from finger movement to everyday confidence.

Level 1

Physical / Mechanical

  • Supports repetitive motion exercises that rebuild finger flexion and extension
  • Assists gentle, consistent opening and closing movement
  • Helps retain warmth around the hand before movement work
  • Encourages circulation through repeated guided motion

Level 2

Functional / Everyday Life

  • Rebuilds motions used for gripping, pinching, and hand control
  • Bridges the gap between clinical exercise and holding a fork again
  • Designed for short, frequent sessions that fit around a normal day

Level 3

Clinical / Recovery-Oriented

  • Complements prescribed physical or occupational therapy
  • Encourages consistency, a key factor in neuroplasticity-driven recovery
  • Helps patients and caregivers notice progress between clinical visits

Level 4

Emotional / Psychological

  • Small visible wins rebuild confidence, not just muscle
  • Reduces the helpless feeling that can follow loss of hand function
  • Gives family members a concrete way to support recovery

Questions Before You Order

Clear answers for common buyer concerns

Is this a replacement for physical therapy?

No. The glove is designed to complement prescribed physical or occupational therapy, not replace professional care.

How soon can I expect to see results?

Recovery timelines vary by condition, consistency, and severity. Many users focus on small measurable wins such as more repetitions, better grip control, or easier daily tasks.

Is it safe to use without supervision?

For general stiffness, many people use it at home. After stroke, surgery, nerve injury, or a diagnosed condition, use it with guidance from your clinician or therapist.

What conditions is this not recommended for?

Do not use it over open wounds, untreated fractures, severe pain, active swelling that has not been assessed, or any condition your clinician has advised against exercising.

How often should I use it per day or week?

Short, frequent sessions are usually easier to maintain than long sessions. Follow your therapist's advice and stop if you feel pain or unusual discomfort.

Does it fit different hand sizes?

The glove uses adjustable support for secure hand placement. Contact us before ordering if you are unsure about fit.

Can I pay when it is delivered?

Payment on delivery is available in Accra after your order is confirmed. Orders outside Accra require advance payment before dispatch.
